name: Myrkos
description: The Myrkos was a Galactic Republic dreadnaught cruiser in service during the Clone Wars. It was stationed in orbit around Tembora, a mobile rogue moon that housed the Republic's Tembora Research Station. At one point, enemy forces launched an attack on the research station, with the Myrkos becoming critically damaged during the fighting. The starship crashed into the rogue moon, leaving behind a radioactive crater and altering the mobile celestial body's course in space.
